A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ScalingAR and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–D. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of the complete work.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, component ablations, scalability and robustness experiments, and a 15-participant user study in Section 5 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark, ablation, scalability, robustness and user-study results, including the supplementary analyses and qualitative examples.

M1.justification: The dual-channel confidence profile, adaptive termination gate and guidance scheduler are unchanged. Equation 10 adds a hat to the conditional-score symbol without changing its formula or documenting a procedural revision.

E1.justification: Both versions use GenEval, TIIF-Bench, filtered IPV-TXT impossible prompts and the same human-preference study. No dataset, task or test-scenario coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same LlamaGen and AR-GRPO comparisons with IS and BoN, alongside the same reference generators. The newly cited Guo et al. (2025b) appears only in Related Work, without joining any reported experimental comparison.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix A retain the same model configurations, image resolutions, benchmark metrics, scaling settings, impossible-prompt evaluation procedure and 15-participant MOS protocol.

E4.justification: Table 2's component ablations, Figures 5–6's scalability and robustness analyses, Appendix A's hyperparameter and termination-threshold analyses, and Appendix B's qualitative examples are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting in the results, plots and user-study description is unchanged. v2 introduces no repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests or other uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plots and qualitative examples match. For example, Table 1 retains ScalingAR's GenEval/TIIF-Bench overall scores of 0.36/46.47 with LlamaGen and 0.49/26.35 with AR-GRPO.

T1.justification: The mathematical expressions and derivations are retained. Equation 10 changes D_t to D-hat_t, matching notation already used in Equation 11 and the surrounding prose; this is a notation edit rather than revised mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements and conclusion retain the same novelty claims about NTP-specific test-time scaling and visual-token entropy, together with the same claimed quality, efficiency and robustness benefits.

C2.justification: The interpretations of confidence signals, component effectiveness, efficiency, scalability and robustness are unchanged. Appendix C retains the same limitations concerning uncertainty capture and dependence on model calibration and architecture.

D1.justification: Appendix A preserves the hardware disclosure, hyperparameter table, prompt details, filtering description and user-study instructions. The code-repository link also points to the same destination.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Ziyu Guo et al. (2025b), describing its application of reward-based Best-of-N to AR image generation and distinguishing it from ScalingAR's strategy design. It also revises the nearby discussion of entropy-based LLM reasoning and early decoding, providing a limited positioning update.

P1.justification: Part of the Test-Time Scaling paragraph in Related Work is rewritten, Equation 10 receives a notation correction, and the version stamp changes. The remaining narrative and section structure, including the appendices, are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10 and all tables retain their content and presentation. The revised paragraph changes spacing on page 3, while the added reference causes bibliography entries to reflow across pages 10–13; these are limited layout changes.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves research positioning by acknowledging a previously unmentioned relevant work and explaining its claimed distinction from ScalingAR in Section 2. Equation 10 also uses more consistent notation. These are limited attribution and clarity gains; the method, empirical support and stated limitations remain unchanged.
